data.name: Jawadiyah
data.gender_notes: Jawadiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawadiyah originates from the Arabic word 'Jawad' which means generous, munificent. It is a unisex name used in Arabic, Urdu and Persian cultures. The name Jawadiyah carries the meaning “Generous, Munificent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawadiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, munificent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, being generous and munificent is considered a noble trait, often associated with Allah's attributes. This name signifies one who embodies these qualities.
data.etymology: Jawadiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Munificent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawadiyah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جوادية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جواد، يعني كريم و سخي و معطاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جوادية مشتق من الجواد، و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني كريم و سخي و معطاء، و من صفات الله الجواد الذي يعطي و يكرم، و يدل على معنى الكرم و الإكثار من الخير

in_urdu.name: جوادیہ
in_urdu.meaning: کرامتی، سخی، عطا کرنے والا، اللہ کی صفت
in_urdu.long_meaning: جوادیہ نام کا مطلب ہے کرامتی، سخی، عطا کرنے والا، یہ نام اللہ کی صفت جواد سے لیا گیا ہے، جو کریم اور سخی ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जवाडिया
in_hindi.meaning: كرامي، سخي، عطا کرنے والا، अल्लाह कि صفت
in_hindi.long_meaning: जवाडिया नाम का अर्थ है کرامتی، سخی، عطा करने वाला، यह नाम अल्लाह की सिफत جواد से लिया गया है, जो कि क्रीम और سخی है, और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत उपयोग होता है

in_pashto.name: جوادېه
in_pashto.meaning: د جواد څخه اخستل شوی، کریم، سخي، ورکوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جوادېه نوم د جواد څخه اخستل شوی دی، جو د الله ښه نوم دی، معنی یې کریم، سخي، ورکوونکی، او د الله صفت جواد چې ډیر خیر ورکوونکی دی

in_english.name: Jawadiyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Jawad, meaning generous, kind, and giver
in_english.long_meaning: Jawadiyah is derived from the Arabic root 'J-W-D', which means to be generous or kind. This name signifies the attributes of kindness, generosity, and charity, reflecting the spiritual values of compassion and benevolence in Islamic tradition
